title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(小山正人研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Koyama Masato)
keywords: Power electronics 2.Motor control 3.Storage device 4.Power generation device 5.Modelling
educationalGoal: [Theme] Research on modelling and control of power electronics systems such as motor drive systems [Target] To learn theme setting, writing research reports and presenting research reports To write a research report
advice: [Course Description] Research project is performed as a team of two or three members. Weekly report needs to be written to show progress of the project and weekly meeting is held using the weekly report. Final project reports need to be written and presentation is required at PDIII presentation meeting. [Expectations for Students] This course is the final course of Project Design and integrates knowledge and skills obtained at the other expertise courses. Students are required to review the basic courses and to obtain expertise through PDIII.
requiredKnowledge: Power electronics is an interdisciplinary field based on many specialized engineering such as electrical engineering and mechanical engineering. It's difficult to get sufficient knowledge on these engineering, but it's necessary to review textbooks when necessary.

activityGoals.body: To clarify objectives and targets of the research and to make the research plan
To have a good communication with team members and instructor and to proceed research
To solve problems in the research
To write a project report as the final result of PDIII
To explain research contents and to present research results

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
